cases.why: The INPUT[type=checkbox] carries the HTML 'checked' attribute (isPretickedInput → true) and its 'name' attribute is 'accept', which matches ACCEPT_PATTERN /\b(accept|agree|allow|enable|yes|ok|got it|verstanden|akzeptieren)\b/i (isAcceptLikeControl → true). Both conditions are met; PRIVACY_DP_PRETICKED is emitted on the element's selector. evaluate() produces ruleId 'privacy-dp-preticked' with severity 'critical'. Under GDPR Art. 4(11) a pre-ticked consent box is not a freely given, unambiguous affirmative act.

The INPUT[type=radio] carries 'checked' (isPretickedInput → true) and aria-label='Accept all', which matches ACCEPT_PATTERN via the 'accept' word (isAcceptLikeControl → true). Both conditions met; finding fires with severity 'critical'. A pre-selected 'Accept all' radio is the same dark pattern as a pre-ticked checkbox under GDPR Recital 32.
